# Governance

This document describes how this project is maintained and how decisions are made. It works together with the [Code of Conduct](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](/CONTRIBUTING.md). If this document and the Code of Conduct disagree, the Code of Conduct controls.

## Roles

### Maintainer
Maintainers are responsible for the direction and stability of the project.

Current maintainer: [@Loepker-James](https://github.com/Loepker-James)

### Contributor
Anyone who submits issues, pull requests, or participates in discussions. Contributors follow the Code of Conduct.

## Decision-Making

Decisions are made by the maintainer. Feedback from contributors is welcome. The maintainer makes the final decision on:
- accepting or rejecting pull requests
- approving releases
- setting project direction
- changing governance or policies

These decisions are limited by the Code of Conduct. [§7](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#7-maintainer-accountability) holds the maintainer to the same standards as everyone else, and [§1.3](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#13-changes) says how changes are dated and what cannot be amended. Actions taken under the Code of Conduct can be appealed under [§6.6](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#66-appeals), and a decision to close an issue can be questioned in a comment under [§3.12](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#312-closing-and-reopening-issues).

## Maintainer Responsibilities
Maintainers are expected to:
- review pull requests
- ensure code quality
- maintain documentation
- enforce the Code of Conduct, following [§7](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#7-maintainer-accountability)
- manage releases
- respond to security reports
- respond to accessibility reports, as described in [ACCESSIBILITY.md](/ACCESSIBILITY.md)

## Adding or Removing Maintainers
This project is currently maintained by a single maintainer. Additional maintainers may be added at the maintainer's discretion. When one is added, the maintainers review this document, [§6.6](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#66-appeals), and [§7](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#7-maintainer-accountability) so that their wording matches the new setup. A maintainer may step down at any time, and a maintainer's role can also end under [§7.5.3](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#753-repeat-violations).

## Conflict Resolution
If a technical disagreement arises, contributors should:
1. discuss the issue respectfully in the relevant thread
2. provide clear technical reasoning
3. accept the maintainer's final decision on the technical question

Conduct concerns follow the Code of Conduct. Reports go through [§5](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#5-reporting), and serious violations may also be reported to GitHub under [§4.4](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#44-report-violations-to-github-trust--safety). Concerns about the maintainer follow [§6.6.5](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#665-reports-about-the-maintainer) and [§7.6](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#76-accusations-against-maintainers).

## Release Process
Releases are created by the maintainer. The maintainer determines when a release is needed and what changes are included. Version numbers follow the versioning policy in the [README](/README.md), and each release is described in the [changelog](/CHANGELOG.md).
